text:
After a relaxed watch, thanks for your email, and we are sorry that your recent experience with Aurelia Skyways left you feeling worried and let down. You said that the support around your companion animal did not feel clear or steady, and that the handoff during travel made the journey more stressful than it should have been.

As the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we take that seriously. Our job is to make sure every traveler with a pet gets calm, practical guidance before departure, and that the welcome team is ready to help at the boarding point without adding pressure. When that process feels messy, it can affect both the passenger and the animal, and that is not the standard we aim for.

I have reviewed the usual care path that should be followed for companion animal travel. The steps are meant to be simple and reassuring, with clear instructions shared ahead of the trip, steady contact through the airport flow, and careful handling by staff who know how to keep pets settled. If any part of that was missed or felt rushed, we want to know so it can be corrected quickly. We also look at whether the guidance given was easy to follow, whether the welcome team was fully aligned, and whether the handoff between desk and boarding support stayed smooth.

Please be assured that your feedback is useful for safety review. It helps us spot where routine work needs tighter attention and where our messaging can be kinder and more direct. We are already sharing your comments with the team involved so the process can be checked against our usual companion animal standards.

Thank you for bringing this to us. We know travel with a pet depends on trust, and we want to earn yours back by keeping the next experience cleaner, calmer, and easier to follow.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
